answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can trade. If signed, auditable records prove fraud, randomly selected independent reviewers can slash the offender’s bond and receive a share. A fake cannot merely echo a legitimate agent’s claims to pass those checks: each Sybil identity needs its own stake, tying up capital and risking forfeiture. The inlet admits agents only after staking, and random selection makes it harder for a colluding knoll to control review.
